module.purpose: Defines the Collection interface and factory function for creating typed collections with schema validation, change tracking, and synchronization capabilities. Acts as the primary entry point for the database collection system.
module.summary: This file exports the Collection interface and createCollection factory function for creating typed collections with schema validation, change tracking, and synchronization. It provides multiple overloads to handle different combinations of schema, utilities, and result types. The CollectionImpl class orchestrates multiple manager components (state, sync, mutations, events, indexes, lifecycle, changes) to provide a complete collection experience with virtual properties, transaction support, and subscription-based change detection.
module.businessContext: Provides the core data collection abstraction for the TanStack DB system. Collections manage typed data with automatic change detection, schema validation, and synchronization. Failure breaks type safety, data integrity, and the entire reactive data layer.
classes: CollectionImpl (~L260-582): Main collection implementation class managing state, sync, mutations, events, and indexes through composition
Collection (~L49-68): Enhanced interface extending CollectionImpl with utilities and optional singleResult flag
functions: createCollection (~L70-258): Factory function with multiple overloads for creating typed collections, handling schema inference and utilities attachment
buildCompareOptionsFromConfig (~L584-601): Helper function to build string collation options from collection configuration
